title: Veriface
description: Veriface service: traffic, errors, latency, stages, capacity, check drift, verification outcomes.

panels.title: Scrape up
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape /metrics. Readiness itself (/health/ready) needs a blackbox probe: see ops/README.md.

panels.title: Ready (probe)
panels.description: Blackbox exporter probe of /health/ready (200 only after warm-up and until shutdown). No data = no probe configured.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests holding a processing slot (max = server.max_concurrency).

panels.title: Queued
panels.description: Requests waiting for a slot. At server.queue_limit (default 32) new requests get 503 overloaded.

panels.title: Errors by problem code
panels.description: The metrics carry the HTTP status, not the problem code; the status is mapped to its problem code(s) from contracts/openapi.yaml. 503 covers both overloaded (queue full / timeout) and not-ready; 422 covers image-decode-failed and image-too-large. Logs carry the exact code.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (endpoint, status) (rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*", status!~"2.."}[$__rate_interval])), "problem", "400 invalid-request", "status", "400"), "problem", "401 unauthorized", "status", "401"), "problem", "403 profile-forbidden", "status", "403"), "problem", "404 profile-not-found / not-found", "status", "404"), "problem", "405 method-not-allowed", "status", "405"), "problem", "413 payload-too-large", "status", "413"), "problem", "415 unsupported-media-type", "status", "415"), "problem", "422 image-decode-failed / image-too-large", "status", "422"), "problem", "429 rate-limited", "status", "429"), "problem", "500 internal", "status", "500"), "problem", "503 overloaded / not-ready", "status", "503")

sum by (endpoint) (rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (endpoint) (rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

sum by (endpoint) (rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*", status="503"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (endpoint) (rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

sum by (endpoint) (rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*", status=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (endpoint) (rate(face_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: p99 by endpoint
panels.description: Histogram buckets: 5 ms ... 30 s. A p99 at 30 s means requests ran into server.request_timeout_ms.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (rate(face_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (endpoint) (rate(face_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", endpoint=~"/v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Stage p95
panels.description: queue = waiting for a processing slot; upload = reading the multipart body; then decode, detect, landmarks, segment, measure, document, risk, embed, evaluate, output. A rising queue p95 is the first sign of saturation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage) (rate(face_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Time spent per stage (seconds per second)
panels.description: Busy time by stage across all requests. With parallel_stages on, stages of one verification overlap, so this can exceed wall-clock time per request.

panels.title: In flight and queued
panels.description: Gauges sampled at scrape time. in flight <= max_concurrency; queued <= queue_limit.

panels.title: Reject rate per check (fail / evaluated)
panels.description: Share of evaluated results that failed, per check. A check whose reject rate climbs while traffic is steady signals drift: capture conditions, client app change, or a model/profile change. Selfie and document results are not separated in the metric.

targets.expr: (sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status="fail"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status=~"pass|fail|undetermined"}[$__rate_interval]))) / clamp_min(sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status=~"pass|fail|undetermined"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Reject rate vs. 7 days ago (ratio)
panels.description: Current hourly reject rate divided by the same hour a week ago. 1 = unchanged. The drift alert fires on this signal.

targets.expr:
(sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status="fail"}[1h])) / clamp_min(sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status=~"pass|fail|undetermined"}[1h])), 1e-9))
 / clamp_min(sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status="fail"}[1h] offset 7d)) / clamp_min(sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status=~"pass|fail|undetermined"}[1h] offset 7d)), 1e-9), 0.005)

panels.title: Undetermined rate per check
panels.description: A check that could not be measured (e.g. no face found upstream).

targets.expr: (sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status="undetermined"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status=~"pass|fail|undetermined"}[$__rate_interval]))) / clamp_min(sum by (check) (rate(face_check_status_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", check=~"$check", status=~"pass|fail|undetermined"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Outcome share
panels.description: A rising rejected or review share at steady traffic is a drift or abuse signal; a rising retake share points at capture quality.

panels.title: Early rejects, rate limits and config reloads
Unread request bodies (early rejects)
panels.description: Bodies left unread when the service answers early (401, 413, 429, 503...). drained: read and discarded, the client gets the response. not_sent: Expect: 100-continue, never uploaded. too_large / busy / timeout / error: the connection was closed with the body unread, so a client still uploading may see a connection reset instead of the response. busy (no drain slot) and timeout above zero are alerted.

panels.title: Rate limited (429) by project
panels.description: 429 rate-limited answers by API key project and reason: rate (the key's request rate) or concurrency (the key's concurrent-request limit). No data until per-key limits are configured.

panels.title: Config reloads
panels.description: Hot reloads of API keys and profiles (P4: no data until reloads land). error: a reload was refused (details in the log). Any error is alerted.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: veriface does not export process_* metrics yet (the prometheus crate is built without its "process" feature). This panel shows windows_exporter (process collector) or cAdvisor series when they exist.

options.content:
**Metrics source:** `service/crates/face-server/src/metrics.rs`.

- Error panels map HTTP status to problem codes; the exact code is in the JSON logs.
- Check metrics do not separate selfie, document and verification results.
- Readiness needs a blackbox probe of `/health/ready` (job selected by `$probe_job`).
- Process memory/CPU need windows_exporter or cAdvisor until the service exports `process_*`.
- Rate-limit and config-reload panels stay empty until those features are configured / released.
- Alerts: `ops/prometheus/alerts.yml`.
